description: Point at one desktop UI element with a small arrow bubble (no dimming or tour). For when a sentence is clearer with a finger on its subject. Get selectors from tour(action='targets'), prefer stable:true, never guess. One tip at a time (new replaces last); say the same thing in chat too — the bubble is a pointer, not the message. Sparingly: a bubble every turn stops being read.
name: show_tip

side.description: Omit for 'top'; flips at screen edges.
